text: A Rouge National Urban Park Welcome Centre as part of a Conservation Precinct in the vicinity of the Zoo is a shared vision of the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo and Parks Canada. This report updates the Board on discussions regarding the proposed Welcome Centre.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (August 15, 2019) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo. 2. Directed the public release of Confidential Attachment 1 at the discretion of the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo.
